# `lpad`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns `str`, left-padded with `pad` to a length of `len`.
If `str` is longer than `len`, the return value is shortened to `len` characters or bytes.
If `pad` is not specified, `str` will be padded to the left with space characters if it is
a character string, and with zeros if it is a byte sequence.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
lpad(str, len[, pad])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- lpad, example 1
> SELECT lpad('hi', 5, '??');
???hi
```

```sql
-- lpad, example 2
> SELECT lpad('hi', 1, '??');
h
```

```sql
-- lpad, example 3
> SELECT lpad('hi', 5);
   hi
```

```sql
-- lpad, example 4
> SELECT hex(lpad(unhex('aabb'), 5));
000000AABB
```

```sql
-- lpad, example 5
> SELECT hex(lpad(unhex('aabb'), 5, unhex('1122')));
112211AABB
```
